toc.title: Genealogiam Ahmedis III, hodierni Imperatoris Turcici, ab Adamo deductam.
Desiderii Pacii Stricturæ breves in Cl. D. Friderici Spanhemii fil. Epistolam ad amicum.
Nupera D. Friderici Spanhemii F. Epistola ad amicum, quâ exhibet novissima circa res sacras in Belgio dissidia. Amici ad amicum epistolium.

book: A 1676 volume of short printed pieces bound together: a Turkish genealogy plate (scan 4), Desiderius Pacius' Stricturae breves against Spanheim's letter on the Dutch church disputes, with its title pages and text (scans 5–64), and a further title for a letter from a friend (scan 69).
